outcome: distribution of caesarean sections by Robson group
cohort: Consecutive mothers who had deliveries at a tertiary referral centre in Somalia between January 2022 and July 2023.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 38.2%, with Robson groups 5 and 10 identified as the major contributors to CSs.
mod_finding: The study found an overall caesarean section rate of 38.2%, with Robson groups 5 (11.4%) and 10 (9.4%) being the highest absolute contributors to CSs.
